headings.strategy: Expressive, tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large sizes, font-bold or font-black for major titles.

body.strategy: Clean, readable text, geometric, with leading-relaxed.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Gap of gap-6 or gap-8 in grids.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense data. Center hero text and empty states.

components_strategy.cards: Dark flat backgrounds with 1px border-white/10. No heavy box shadows, use subtle glowing drop-shadows on hover.

buttons.live_tv_vod: Make them significantly larger (e.g., py-4 px-8 text-xl) and position them lower in the hero section or viewport for better user reachability (ergonomic mobile design).

banners.behavior: Hybrid sizing: auto-size on desktop, responsive 100% width on mobile. Ensure images use object-cover or object-contain properly depending on ad specifications.

technical_instructions_to_main_agent: Multi-banner order: Implement a round-robin rotation or sequence (e.g., ad network 1 on line 1, ad network 2 on line 2, etc.) for ad snippets.
Banner size behavior: Set to auto-size based on native banner dimensions, hybrid strategy (auto-size on desktop, responsive/scaled on mobile).
Custom notifications: Build an admin toggle to show/hide notifications on the public page for Live matches, Partnerships, Ads.

Parental Controls PIN: Store session state (e.g., in sessionStorage or React Context) so the PIN is required only 1 time per session, and apply this guard ONLY for categories explicitly marked as 'restricted' (like 'Big Brother').
Source folder cleanup: Ensure any raw/source code folders are removed or ignored from the public/build directory to prevent source code leakage.
VOD statistics: Implement or fix tracking for VOD view counts and watch times.
Live TV and VOD buttons: Increase their physical size (`h-14` or `h-16`, `text-lg`) and move them lower in the layout hierarchy (closer to the thumb zone on mobile).

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: All interactive elements, forms, and ad containers MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='live-tv-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Overlay text on images must have text-shadow.

image_urls.description: Abstract live sports TV screen for hero background
Dark empty vintage cinema hall for VOD hero or empty state background
